newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CRUYFF BEGINS FRESH LEGAL ACTION AGAINST BARCELONA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CRUYFF BEGINS FRESH LEGAL ACTION AGAINST BARCELONA.

text.p: Johan Cruyff has begun fresh legal action against Barcelona to recover seven million pesetas ($56,000) in wages and bonuses which he claims are owed to him from his final two months at the club.
Since being sacked as coach in May, Cruyff has begun a case claiming unfair dismissal and is considering launching another for slander against Barcelona chairman Jose Luis Nunez.
Cruyff's financial adviser Jaume Roures said he had asked the club for the money but had been told that it was a matter for the board of directors.
"It should have been paid at the moment of the sacking and is therefore a debt," said Roures.
